what: Phase 2: Extract function and class call relationships
why: Provide a detailed low-level map of function invocation dependencies in the codebase instead of just file-level imports.
learned: A fast O(1) in-memory word matching tokenization scanner parses method and function calls reliably, mapping start lines to record call lines in source_location. Standardizing trim space on findLineNumber prevents newlines from breaking symbol line matching.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: Call relationships are now parsed dynamically for Go, JS, Py, PHP, etc. Test TestSyncGraphWithCalls validates exact source/target and line number L4 mapping.
next_steps: Proceed to Phase 3: markdown document parsing.
